appContext.category: fire watch and security patrol logging for security companies
appContext.summary: Phoenix Fire Watch lets fire watch and security patrol companies manage monitored properties, log patrols with live time-stamped photos and status (Clear, Follow-up, Incident), run repeating patrol timers that alert officers 5 minutes before each patrol is due, clock in and out of shifts, share team watch notes, and send signed PDF shift reports to property contacts. Works offline and syncs with the web dashboard.

theme.style: Night-shift command center: near-black and charcoal canvases lit by low, smoldering ember-red glows like warning beacons and emergency lighting seen through haze. The mood is calm, vigilant and authoritative, never chaotic, with fine smoke wisps, dark glass layers and subtle grain. Crimson #DC2626 light sits low in the frame and the upper area stays dark and quiet for headlines.
